HypnoLog Documentation ============================ *HypnoLog* aims to be the single tool for visualizing all you data from any platform. This is done by the following described architecture. # Architecture Logging with HypnoLog done by sending HTTP requests to HypnoLog, therefor it is possible to log from any language/technology/environment as log as it possible to send HTTP request from it. Second step is to view the logged data, this is done by accessing the web UI using the browser. The browser is simple receiving the data from the same HypnoLog server. In the most simple scenario all 3 parts (logging code, HypnoLog server, browser) can run on the same machine. # Visualization Archite...
